ios.desc:
Love sports talk? Stacks is THE place for fun, interactive sports conversations. Watch and join fans, athletes and media personalities talking and debating sports in real time. Vote and comment on your favorite takes, post video responses, or create your own conversation!

Our community features thousands of fans like you are voicing opinions and debating hot topics daily. Invite friends to join conversations, engage with your favorite personalities, earn points for your opinions and climb the leaderboards, or even build your following and become a sports influencer!

Use stacks to:

•Discover trending topics from athletes, media personalities, and other fans and JOIN their conversation!
•Add your voice to our growing community of the next generation of sports media voices--it’s as easy as recording quick video on a trending sports topics or joining an ongoing conversation
•Vote for your favorite content creators and earn points for your takes
•Create and publish content to social platforms and websites

quotes.text:
SportsMe | IOS Engineer, Backend Engineer, Mobile Designer | Boston,MA | Onsite | https://getsportsme.com

SportsMe, the fan conversation platform. We are a sports focused media platform that allows fans to be the experts on their favorite teams, players and general knowledge of the game. Our first product has been the SportsMe IOS app(https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1291610886) that allows you to take on your friends, fellow fans, and rivals in 30 second video debates on trending sports topics. We are tired of listening to the same talking heads of sports and their network directed opinions, we are changing the way fans obtain their sports news and opinions with a platform truly driven by the people with the best voice, the fans.

The stack is fully deployed on AWS Lambda, RDS, and using GraphQL. We run the backend on Node.js. We use a combination of Swift, Firebase, and Apollo-GraphQL to power the IOS app.

Current Product: https://itunes.apple.com/app/id1291610886
Apply and Find Job descriptions via: via https://getsportsme.com/jobs
